subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: The teacher said to the girl, "Do you think that honesty is the best policy?" The girl said, "Yes, sir, I think so." "Then learn to be honest from your childhood," said the teacher. "Thank you, sir," said the girl. "May Allah bless you," said the teacher.
